name: eyebrow
label: Eyebrow
help_text: Small uppercase label above the heading. Leave blank to hide it.

name: show_eyebrow_rule
label: Show Gold Rule
help_text: A short gold rule above the eyebrow. Works with or without eyebrow text.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Visual size, independent of the heading level. Follows theme typography.

name: animate_heading
label: Type Heading On Scroll
help_text: The heading types itself in the first time it scrolls into view. Plays once, and is skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

name: description

name: item_text_size
label: Item Text Size
help_text: Visual size only, using the theme's type scale. Auto uses the tag's own size.

name: animate_items
label: Reveal items on scroll
help_text: The names fade up into the grid one after another as the section enters the viewport.

name: note
label: Note
help_text: Optional closing text below the grid.
default: Migration is also an opportunity to decide what should be kept, cleaned, redesigned or left behind.

name: intro_align
label: Alignment
help_text: Alignment of the intro, the items and the note.
